feat: resolve JSON Pointers (RFC 6901)

Add resolvePointer(document, pointer), which returns the value a JSON
Pointer refers to. It throws when the pointer is not valid syntax (no
leading slash, or a "~" not followed by 0 or 1) and when it does not
resolve in the document (missing or inherited member, out-of-range or
non-canonical array index, or a path through a scalar or null).

Refs task-001-implement-json-pointer-resolution-rfc-6901
